answer: Identity weight comes from expiring service receipts. During a 20-epoch probation, each account must obtain one receipt per epoch from a randomly drawn buyer, and no buyer may sign twice for the same funding cluster. The kth linked alias needs k distinct buyers, so 100 fakes require 5,050 independent trades. A vine commitment binds each draw; validators replay receipts through the karst graph, and a hollow or reused buyer resets the entire cluster for 20 epochs.
